section.p: My name is Francisco but you can call me Fran! As a Software Engineer, I’ve been 'introducing' bugs since 2011!

Lately, I have been working on my fundamentals! Aka: Data structures and Algorithms along with System designs (not to confuse with Design Systems! 🤣). You can check my progression by looking at the Algorithms public repo I have 😊.
My real passion lies in engineering captivating digital experiences. Versatile and adaptive, I thrive in various settings, shifting effortlessly from hands-on coding to spearheading dynamic teams.
